title: One complete-package hash per opened PPTX commit, and the publication stops re-deriving the snapshot it was handed
decision: retained: 0587 item PPTX-1 parts (a) and (b) implemented; part (c) written up as a design prerequisite and not implemented; part (d) examined and rejected
code_state: crates/litchi-pptx only: opened/model.rs, opened/patch.rs, opened/transaction.rs, opened/mod.rs, package/model.rs, opened/tests.rs
reason_codes: an opened PPTX lifecycle hashed the complete package six times and captured it five times; two of those hashes were of content the caller had already hashed or already captured in the same lifecycle

the reuse in Transaction::commit is conditional on OpcPackage::is_signed, which is true whenever unsign could rewrite any input package_fingerprint feeds, so a signature-stripping commit is re-hashed exactly as before

the reuse in apply_opened_presentation_commit is conditional on packages_equal, a direct comparison of exactly the fingerprint inputs; a false result falls back to the ordinary capture, so drift outside the patch write set still produces a snapshot of the real package
no revision value changes, so the durable LPRM0001 and LPCP0002 patch encodings that carry complete-package revisions are bit-identical and previously serialized patches still apply
0587 item (c) redefines the revision itself and therefore breaks those two durable encodings; it needs a frozen design record and a magic bump before any code

accepted_evidence.call_counts: callgrind call counts per callee for package_fingerprint, the capture entry point, notes::load_snapshot, packages_equal and Snapshot::rebound_to, both legs, four selectors, at --warmup 0 --samples 1
accepted_evidence.isolation_pair: callgrind at --samples 1 and --samples 3 on pptx_eager_batch_edit_save, differenced over two samples: per lifecycle 12,679,371,772 -> 10,680,374,116 Ir (-15.77%), six hashes and five captures -> four and four
accepted_evidence.symbol_shares: package_fingerprint inclusive 34.94% -> 24.76%, the capture entry point 33.30% -> 21.38%, software sha2::compress256 51.77% -> 44.60%; the harness's own sha256_hex and every deflate symbol are unchanged to within seven instructions, which is the output-identity cross-check
accepted_evidence.paired_timing: four legs in A1 B1 B2 A2 order, 30 measured samples after 3 warmups each, taskset -c 10, with the A/A (A1 vs A2) and B/B (B1 vs B2) floors from the repeated legs in the same window
accepted_evidence.correctness: cargo test -p litchi-pptx: 860 tests pass, six new; cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy -p litchi-pptx --all-targets and cargo doc -p litchi-pptx --no-deps all clean

accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind runs SHA-256 in software because valgrind masks the SHA CPUID bit, so every hashing share here is about five times its native cycle share
accepted_costs.corpora: the eager PPTX corpora are built through Package::from_opc_package, which sets physical_source_provenance = false, so every eager save re-deflates all media; the timed region is dominated by deflate work this change does not touch
accepted_costs.host_load: seven other agents of the same wave were building and measuring on the other 31 cores throughout; the in-window A/A and B/B floors are the only statement about that
accepted_costs.debug_assert: capture_with_revision and Snapshot::rebound_to re-verify their precondition in debug and test builds only, which roughly doubles the hashing the crate's own test suite performs

known_gaps.remaining_hashes: four complete-package hashes per lifecycle remain; removing them needs 0587 item PPTX-1(c), a durable revision-format change
known_gaps.untouched_paths: the cross-package slide copy (0587 item PPTX-2), the per-call presentation.xml reparse (PPTX-3) and the eager save's whole-deck regeneration (SAVE-3)
known_gaps.notes_memo: 0587 item (d)'s notes-index cache has no owner to hold the memo and its invalidation rule is an ADR 0013 correctness contract, so it is deferred to a design record
known_gaps.measurement: no allocation, RSS, cold-cache, range-source, concurrency or cross-platform measurement was taken, and no selector times PPTX capture, commit, apply and publication separately

withheld: any registered speedup, regression, RSS, allocation, cold-cache, real-producer or cross-platform result

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, valgrind 3.26.0
